model: Flux-following static Polyakov channel action: local dipole stress, tilt and induced current, evaluated on the same finite collar

equations.conventions: S=8piG*T, div Fcal=-Jcal, div S=Fcal.Jcal/2, Fcal_theta_phi=2Q sin(theta); k=alpha/3. Prime means conformal x derivative.
equations.action: Γ2 density before sin³(theta) integration: N²R²*m*(-rho*Ht+p*Hr)/(2Q)+R⁴p*m_prime²/(4Q²), plus intrinsic2D metric response; convention δΓ=integral sqrt(g)*(Sδg+JδA)
equations.state: δw includes prescribed angular seed and complete-loop variation. For fixed spin/holonomy ground state, δw_geometry=-2w*δL/L. Local collar contributes δL=integral(Hr-Ht)dx/2; exterior/end terms unresolved.
equations.nonvacuum_gravity: If E1=δ(R_ab-T_EM_ab/2), use δEinstein=E1-g tr(E1)/2-h R0/2+g*(h^ab E0_ab)/2, E0=R_ab-T_EM_ab/2. Electrovac-only trace conversion is insufficient here.

coupled_proper_distance_equations.convention: Q=1; h=Ht,v=Hr,m=magnetic potential; A=N_l/N,B=R_l; dots denote proper l derivatives. δS coefficients are divided by cos(theta).
coupled_proper_distance_equations.remaining: A consistent boundary-value problem still needs gauge regularization at B->0, complete-loop δw and coupled physical end data. These equations are derived and component-checked; no new full-collar angular solution is asserted.

conditional_coupled_seed_controls.scope: Amplified-alpha numerical control with frozen dipole seed, m=m_l=0 at x=.5 and v=-alpha*s1/N²; h fixed by pressure constraint. Ends at1% coordinate perturbation, not a physical horizon or instability threshold. Physical end data are not chosen by this test.
